title: Light weight.. so light it warped the bottom
text: Light weight.. so light it warped the bottom. bottom bulged tward the elements so now I have a "bowl like pan when I use it.. Handle screw has come loose twice so I put locktite on it and that fixed it (phillips screw).. Pan is awesome.. I use it a lot.. never heated it over 6 on my 1-10 GE... nothing sticks still.. not as good as at first.. but I guess if you want a cheap get buy pan.. this is great.. till its not.. Bought a ninja never stick.. so far.. best non stick pan I have ever bought.. but its fifty bucks.. so..
